interface.longDescription: Escudo Compara is an independent comparison of VPNs, password managers and antivirus software (about 30 brands) with prices in BRL and USD checked on official sites, plus audits, lab tests and known incidents. Content in Portuguese (pt-BR) and Spanish (es). Read-only, no login, stores no personal data. Some links are affiliate links and Escudo Compara may earn a commission at no extra cost to you.
